name: app_prepare
description: Before executing a task, decide which applications it actually needs and prepare them in this SAME running session. For plain TXT creation use the existing PowerShell/Router, not an unnecessary editor. Pass app names, not commands or Host paths. Checks known Guest locations first, otherwise finds a registered Host install and copies only that application's files into the session's read-only package, verifies them in the Guest and returns the Guest exe/path/env. Supports notepad, cmd, powershell and the program_share language tools. This does NOT launch the workload. Poll PREPARING with the SAME request_id and apps; launch only when prepared=true, using the returned Guest path and setup. PREPARED proves Guest files, not GUI usability or job success: observe the actual app or obtain the Router receipt. NEEDS_INSTALL/UNSUPPORTED means prepare the requested app using an official installer through inbox_download/inbox_import and the existing Guest installation flow; never install or execute it on the Host. FAILED/UNKNOWN is not permission to retry input or bypass policy. Existing sessions are preserved.

annotations.title: Prepare task applications in this session
